steps.js: new Promise(r=>{const t=setInterval(()=>{const g=window.__ml.game.getState();const p=g.prompt;const s=g.state;if(p&&p.kind==='PICK_TARGET'&&s&&s.stack.length&&g.answeredPromptId!==p.id){clearInterval(t);r('Blaze X='+s.stack[0].x)}},200);setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(t);r('Timeout Blaze')},30000)})

new Promise(r=>{let n=0;const t=setInterval(()=>{const g=window.__ml.game.getState();const p=g.prompt;const s=g.state;if(p&&p.kind==='SELECT'&&p.mode==='priority'&&s&&s.stack.length===0&&g.answeredPromptId!==p.id&&s.players.find(x=>x.me).battlefield.some(c=>c.name==='Guardian of Vitu-Ghazi')){clearInterval(t);r('fertig nach '+n+' Klicks, nextStop='+p.nextStop)}if(p&&p.kind==='PLAY_MANA'&&g.answeredPromptId!==p.id&&(p.specialTargets||[]).length){const id=p.specialTargets.find(x=>document.querySelector('[data-obj="'+x+'"]'));const el=id&&document.querySelector('[data-obj="'+id+'"]');if(el){n++;el.click()}}},600);setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(t);r('Timeout Einberufen nach '+n)},60000)})

new Promise(r=>{const t=setInterval(()=>{const g=window.__ml.game.getState();const p=g.prompt;const s=g.state;if(p&&p.kind==='SELECT'&&p.mode==='priority'&&s&&s.step==='POSTCOMBAT_MAIN'){clearInterval(t);g.action('PASS_PRIORITY_UNTIL_MY_NEXT_TURN');r('Main 2 nextStop='+p.nextStop+' -> F9')}},150);setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(t);r('Timeout Main 2')},60000)})

new Promise(r=>{const t=setInterval(()=>{const s=window.__ml.game.getState().state;const me=s&&s.players.find(x=>x.me);if(me&&!me.skips){clearInterval(t);r('skips weg, Zug '+s.turn+' '+s.step)}},150);setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(t);r('Timeout Stopp')},30000)})
